decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [160 PAR OS01 P1, 160 PAR OS02 P1, 160 PAR EX10 P1, 160 PAR EX11 P1, 160 PAR EX12 P1, 160 PAR EX51 P1, 160 PAR EX61 P1, Heritage Statement and Flood Risk Assessment. Received: 05/08/2025
160 PAR DES 1100 and Fire Safety Compliance Statement. Received: 21/08/2025
160 PAR PL13 P1, 160 PAR PL14 P1, 160 PAR PL52 P1, 160 PAR PL62 P1, 160 PAR PL8101 P1, Design & Access Statement and Planning Update Statement Letter dated 11.11.25. Received: 11/11/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The windows to be fitted on the roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
Reason: In order to safeguard the architectural and historic interest of the conservation area.

Condition : 5 - The front garden shall retain a minimum 1.2 metre wide clear path to the front door of the property from the street.
Reason: To comply with national guidance as set out in the Government Inclusive Mobility guidance 2005.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, conversion of an existing garage into habitable space, replacement of existing rear roof windows and boundary walls with associated internal alterations to the house.
